# Alistair Drummond Architect

> Cape Town-based architect specialising in residential architecture, heritage renovation, and contemporary new builds across the Western Cape, South Africa.

## Practice

Alistair Drummond Architect is a Cape Town architecture practice based at 2b Van Reenen Street, Newlands. The practice focuses on residential architecture — new builds, extensions, renovations, and heritage work — across Cape Town and the Western Cape.

- [Home](https://alistairdrummondarchitect.co.za/): Practice overview
- [Projects](https://alistairdrummondarchitect.co.za/projects.html): Selected residential projects
- [Gallery](https://alistairdrummondarchitect.co.za/gallery.html): Architectural photography
